answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fakes: full rewards require trades with 20 distinct partners over 10 epochs. A plume of accounts trading among themselves never crosses the jetty, since a cluster is flagged when over 60% of its volume stays internal. Making 100 fakes costs 100 bonds at 50 credits each, 5,000 total, with no full reward absent outside partners, while the tide of trade rewards honest agents who pay one bond and keep undiluted rewards.
